description: This file is a shell script responsible for managing network bridge services, DHCP client handling, interface setup/teardown, firewall configuration, and related network operations on a router or embedded device. It contains functions for starting, stopping, and restarting the network bridge, as well as handling DHCP events and interface configurations.

methods.name: unregister_dhcp_client_handlers
methods.description: Unregisters DHCP client event handlers to stop reacting to DHCP events.

methods.name: register_dhcp_client_handlers
methods.description: Registers DHCP client event handlers for restart, release, and renew events.

methods.name: enslave_a_interface
methods.description: Enslaves a network interface to a bridge and configures interface settings.

methods.name: bringup_ethernet_interfaces
methods.description: Stub function, currently no implementation, intended to bring up Ethernet interfaces.

methods.name: teardown_ethernet_interfaces
methods.description: Brings down Ethernet interfaces listed in system configuration.

methods.name: bringup_wireless_interfaces
methods.description: Configures wireless interfaces, setting MAC addresses and other parameters.

methods.name: teardown_wireless_interfaces
methods.description: Brings down wireless interfaces and associated daemons.

methods.name: stop_firewall
methods.description: Stops the firewall if it is running.

methods.name: add_ebtable_rule
methods.description: Adds a NAT PREROUTING rule in ebtables to redirect diagnostic traffic.

methods.name: del_ebtable_rule
methods.description: Removes the ebtables rule added for diagnostic traffic redirection.

methods.name: do_start
methods.description: Performs steps to bring up the network bridge, interfaces, and DHCP or static IP configuration.

methods.name: do_stop
methods.description: Performs steps to shut down the network bridge, interfaces, and clean up configurations.

methods.name: do_start_multi
methods.description: Starts multi-interface bridging, including setting primary net and ebtables rules.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes service configuration, retrieves system parameters, and prepares interface names.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the bridge service, sets up interfaces, firewall, DHCP, and other components.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the bridge service, tears down interfaces, firewall, and cleans up state.
